followup_reviews.Research finding: The Chaman commercial interruption and July 2021 freight return remain included, separately from the August document dispute and returnee-only passenger exceptions. The observed return concerns freight into Afghanistan under Pakistani border authorities. Taliban control is context. Sunday returnees could pass while trade stayed closed. P1 retains unknown onset, trade confirmed closed on 25 July and scoped observed freight return on 26 July. Reuters reports over 100 trucks crossing. Earlier-this-month/month-long wording and earlier passenger openings do not establish a single continuous cargo duration. Retain Uncoded because neither fighting context nor change of control alone establishes the restricting authority’s stated purpose. The Reuters body was freshly read on Euronews; the separate NNI returnee report was reread from preserved text. Syndication is not a second Reuters origin, and the historic source records remain intact. The Chaman/Spin Boldak phase remains unlocated and evidence-only, with no new point or inferred entire-border geometry.
